Meta.title: Onista — Wholesale Patisserie for Cafés
Meta.description: Onista supplies Jeddah's finest cafés with exceptional artisanal desserts, delivered to a fixed weekly schedule.

Hero.ring: Wholesale patisserie · Scheduled delivery · Jeddah · Onista · Est. 2019 ·

About.body: Onista is a dedicated wholesale kitchen: every cake, entremet and viennoiserie is produced to order for our partner cafés, on a fixed weekly delivery schedule you set once and rely on every week. No walk-in counter, no retail queue — just consistent, French-technique pastry, produced to your calendar and invoiced as one clean weekly order.

Tasting.title: Request a tasting box
Tasting.subtitle: For cafés evaluating Onista
Tasting.body: Before you commit to a weekly schedule, taste the range. Tell us which pieces you'd like to sample and our wholesale team will confirm a complimentary tasting box over WhatsApp, usually within the hour — then we'll set up your partner account.
Tasting.perk1Text: Up to three items from the wholesale menu, boxed for your team to taste.
Tasting.perk3Title: A partner account, set up for you
Tasting.perk3Text: Once you're ready, we create your login and your first weekly schedule together.
Tasting.emptyMenu: The tasting menu is being refreshed. Please check back soon.
Tasting.doneBody: We've logged it for our wholesale team. Send the pre-filled message on WhatsApp to confirm your tasting slot.

Footer.tagline: A dedicated wholesale kitchen supplying signature cakes and pastry to Jeddah's best cafés, on a fixed weekly schedule.
